```yaml
name: E2E Portals

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

jobs:
  e2e-portals:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dsherret/rust-toolchain-file@v1

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache Cargo git
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-

      - name: Cache Cargo target
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-target-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-target-

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: tests/e2e/package-lock.json

      - name: Install Playwright dependencies
        working-directory: tests/e2e
        run: |
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Build Rust binaries
        run: |
          cargo build --release --bin tavern
          cargo build --release --bin imixv2
          cargo build --release --bin socks5

      - name: Start Tavern (Server)
        run: |
          ./target/release/tavern > tavern.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > tavern.pid
          # Wait for tavern to be ready (adjust timeout/port as needed)
          sleep 5

      - name: Start Imix (Agent)
        run: |
          ./target/release/imixv2 > imix.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > imix.pid
          # Wait for imix to be ready
          sleep 5

      - name: Run Playwright E2E Tests
        working-directory: tests/e2e
        run: |
          npx playwright test portal.spec.ts

      - name: Retrieve Portal ID via GraphQL
        id: get-portal-id
        run: |
          # Assuming the Playwright test or a helper script outputs the portal ID
          # or we query the API directly. Here we simulate retrieving it.
          # In a real scenario, this might involve curling the GraphQL endpoint.
          # For this workflow, we assume the test script exports the ID or we fetch it.
          # Placeholder: Replace with actual GraphQL query logic if not handled by test.
          PORTAL_ID=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/graphql \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"query": "{ portals { id } }"}' | jq -r '.data.portals[0].id')
          
          if [ -z "$PORTAL_ID" ] || [ "$PORTAL_ID" = "null" ]; then
            echo "Error: Could not retrieve Portal ID"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "portal_id=$PORTAL_ID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Start SOCKS5 Proxy
        run: |
          ./target/release/socks5 --portal-id ${{ steps.get-portal-id.outputs.portal_id }} > socks5.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > socks5.pid
          sleep 2

      - name: Start Mock HTTP Server
        run: |
          # Start a simple HTTP server to act as the target
          python3 -m http.server 8888 --directory /tmp > mock_server.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > mock_server.pid
          sleep 1

      - name: Verify Data Integrity
        run: |
          # Create a test file
          echo "Hello, Realm!" > /tmp/test_file.txt
          ORIGINAL_CHECKSUM=$(sha256sum /tmp/test_file.txt | awk '{print $1}')
          
          # Transfer file through SOCKS5 proxy (assuming proxy is on localhost:1080)
          # Using curl with socks5 proxy
          curl -x socks5h://localhost:1080 http://localhost:8888/test_file.txt -o /tmp/received_file.txt
          
          RECEIVED_CHECKSUM=$(sha256sum /tmp/received_file.txt | awk '{print $1}')
          
          if [ "$ORIGINAL_CHECKSUM" != "$RECEIVED_CHECKSUM" ]; then
            echo "Checksum mismatch!"
            echo "Original: $ORIGINAL_CHECKSUM"
            echo "Received: $RECEIVED_CHECKSUM"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "Data integrity verified successfully."

      - name: Cleanup Processes
        if: always()
        run: |
          kill $(cat tavern.pid) 2>/dev/null || true
          kill $(cat imix.pid) 2>/dev/null || true
          kill $(cat socks5.pid) 2>/dev/null || true
          kill $(cat mock_server.pid) 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Upload Logs on Failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-logs
          path: |
            tavern.log
            imix.log
            socks5.log
            mock_server.log
            tests/e2e/playwright-report/
```
